args.text: Dana asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki with the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 per-seat rate. Hollis is not the owner, so I need your or June's approval before I create the draft.

turns.reply: Dana: a per-seat rate is a finance figure and Hollis is not the account owner, so I need June's or Anselm's approval first. I have asked and will save the draft when one of them says yes.
Ilse: got it, nothing for me to do.

args.subject: Quarrendon 2026 rate
args.body:
Hi Hollis,

The Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Anselm has approved sharing it with you.

Dana

turns.reply: Done, Anselm: the draft from Dana to Hollis is saved, addressed to Hollis only.
